biography: Thiago Perez, born in the bustling favelas of São Paulo, didn't grow up dreaming of Formula One. His racing career began almost by accident. As a young boy, Thiago was helping his uncle at a small garage, mostly fixing up old Volkswagen Fuscas. One day, a local Copa Fusca team needed a last-minute replacement driver. Seeing Thiago's natural talent for mechanics and his reckless abandon on the backstreets, his uncle pushed him into the driver's seat. His raw talent was immediately apparent. His debut race saw him fighting tooth and nail, earning a podium finish despite driving a barely functional car. This unexpected success led to a full-time ride in the Copa Fusca series, where he quickly became a fan favorite for his aggressive driving and unpredictable results. Now, at 30, Thiago is at the peak of his career, a seasoned veteran of the Brazilian racing scene, but still retains that spark of unpredictability that made him famous.
drivingStyle: Thiago's driving style is best described as controlled chaos. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and aggressive corner entries, often pushing the limits of his car and tires. He possesses incredible car control and a knack for finding grip where others can't, allowing him to make daring overtakes. While this aggressive style often yields impressive results, it also leads to frequent incidents and tire wear issues. Under pressure, Thiago tends to become even more aggressive, sometimes making rash decisions that cost him valuable points.
